name: Terminal CRT
author: Parker Brown
description: Curved glass, scanlines and a phosphor glow over the whole desktop — on any Omarchy theme

barWidget.description: The front panel of the set: four knobs — BARREL, FADE, TRACKING, SCANLINE — turning the desktop's CRT glass, with the rest of the tube behind a service flap.

schema.label: Show a percentage under each knob
Wire the shader into Hyprland on first run
schema.description: Writes ~/.config/hypr/crt.lua and a single require() line into hyprland.lua, then renders the shader. Turn this off to install by hand with `crt install`.
